question: Should ClawHub change the published-skill license contract from fixed MIT-0 to stored MIT when root package or license metadata declares standard MIT?
rationale: Current main, docs, and prior maintainer discussion encode fixed MIT-0, while the linked issue and this PR ask ClawHub to preserve declared MIT attribution requirements; automation cannot choose that legal/product contract.

options.title: Decide policy before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open but do not merge until a maintainer explicitly approves or rejects the mixed MIT/MIT-0 contract and the production backfill plan.

options.title: Approve declared MIT support
options.body: Continue review toward merge, but require real Convex/browser proof and an operator-safe runbook for existing versions.

options.title: Reaffirm fixed MIT-0
